title: [finding] a ruling that lands in a COMMENT leaves the card body asserting the opposite, and nothing reconciles them — two cards sat dispatchable for 11 and 15 days telling every reader not to take them
body:
Path: none | ruling procedure (`references/lanes/director.md`) and/or a patrol row beside H58 (`check-half-states.mjs` :13819) | 北极星「优先级」2

Filed by the triage seat (post objectstack#6015, `session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`) out of a near-miss in its own round. ⛔ Lane only; skills-lane findings are graded by that seat.

## The defect

When a ruling lands as a **comment**, the card **body** keeps asserting the opposite, and **nothing reconciles the two**. The body is what a taker reads first, so a ruled card goes on advertising itself as un-dispatchable — indefinitely.

## Two measured instances, both live until this act

| card | ruled | body still said | consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectui#7508 | **2026-09-03**, comment `5529427804` (batch #24, 「其他同意」), which itself records the transition `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` | 「⛔ 本席不裁——这是对已发布 API 的处置,且与维护者裁定的字面直接相抵」 | a `domain:ui#2` seat declined it **2026-09-18** and hung `pm:retriage` asking for the decision box |
| objectui#7750 | **2026-09-07**, comment `5564753628` (batch #66, 「同意」), same recorded transition | 「⛔ So this is a decision card, not an implementation card. Do not dispatch it as 'add canonicalisation.'」 | same seat, same day, same request |

⇒ **two cards sat dispatchable for 11 and 15 days while their own faces told every reader not to take them**, and the seat that stopped was reading correctly — the body it quoted really did say that.

## ⭐ The near-miss, which is the sharper half

The triage seat then **granted both requests**: it applied `needs-user-decision`, removed `pm:queue`, and drafted a 維護者速读 asking the maintainer to pick a letter — **for two questions the maintainer had already answered**. It was stopped by `post-stamped` refusing the body write (「N comment(s) … newer than the body's last write stamp」, demanding `--ack-through`); reading those comments is how the rulings surfaced. Labels had already landed and were rolled back.

⚠️ This is the predecessor shift's recorded catastrophe in miniature — 8 cards re-graded against maintainer rulings, root cause logged verbatim as 「**本席只读 issue 正文,没读评论**」. ⭐ The written lesson **did not prevent the repeat**. What caught it was an unrelated gate that happens to force a comment read before a body write.

## Why a mechanism rather than more discipline

The rule 「每张候选读全文 + 全部评论」 already exists and has now failed at least twice on this exact shape. The state model has no reconciliation between a ruling's carrier (a comment) and the surface a taker reads (the body), and the rulings themselves **do** record their state transition — so the information needed to detect the mismatch is already machine-readable on both sides.

Candidate shapes (⛔ suggestions, not a ruling):
- a patrol row for 「body contains a do-not-dispatch/decision assertion while the card carries a recorded ruling comment」;
- or the director seat's ruling procedure writing the banner onto the body in the same stroke as the label transition it already performs.

⚠️ ⛔ Not proposing a new label or a new state — both instances were in the **correct** state the whole time. The defect is purely that the body contradicted it.
